definitions.explanation: Honorific expression used to politely refer to someone's arrival or visit, typically used in customer service or formal settings.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{来店|らいてん}→ご来店：24462_goraiten⟧、お{越|こ}し⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for visiting our store.

examples.japanese: お{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、お⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧がけ⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please feel free to call out to us when you come by.

examples.japanese: ぜひ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{越|こ}し⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
お{近|ちか}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ぜひお⟦{立|た}ち{寄|よ}り→立ち寄る：04638_tachiyoru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please do stop by whenever you are in the area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本日|ほんじつ}→本日：09643_honjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{遠|とお}い→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{越|こ}し⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦{誠|まこと}→誠：27623_makoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you very much for coming all this way today.

notes:
USAGE:
お{越|こ}し is the honorific (⟦{尊敬語|そんけいご}→尊敬語：17106_sonkeigo⟧) form of ⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧ (to come) or ⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go), used to respectfully refer to someone else's movement.
Very common in customer service, announcements, and formal invitations. You'll hear this frequently at stores, hotels, and tourist destinations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{越|こ}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (honorific verb form: to come/go)
- お{越|こ}し⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ (humble reception: to have someone come)
- お{越|こ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (when you come)
- お{越|こ}し⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧ (please come)
